title: From Seed to Harvest: Augmenting Human Creativity with AI for Red-teaming Text-to-Image Models
reasoning: The paper evaluates religious representation and bias as part of its red-teaming benchmark for Text-to-Image models. It uses religious stereotypes (specifically the 'Friday Prayers' example) to illustrate implicit adversarial prompts and includes 'religion' as a key demographic indicator in its prompt expansion methodology and 'Hate' as a core failure category.
